title: Local browser sign-in, identity binding, and reload custody
description: A local-only product-shaped auth recipe proving an app-owned external assertion seam, immutable issuer/subject binding, protected app data, IndexedDB session restoration, logout, and public gateway omission.

backend.stalenessPolicy: regenerate with codegen; freshness tracked by artifacts.json inputsHash

seed.profile: two deterministic app-owned users; the sessions witness installs the same closed rows through its private setup operation

browser-auth-witness.toolchain: node>=24, Vite, a qualified Snapback runtime, and system Chrome

password-auth-custody-witness.toolchain: node>=24, Vite, a qualified Snapback runtime, and system Chrome

browser-auth-witness: a replaceable server-side verifier accepts a signed external assertion and refuses tampering and nonce mismatch
the trusted server binds immutable issuer plus subject to exactly one app user before staging a browser exchange
the browser reaches only an exact route allowlist that omits fixture setup, principal binding, mailbox, and host operations
the protected viewer query takes no user selector and resolves the app user only from ctx.auth.userId
AuthCoordinator with createIndexedDbAuthCustodyStorage restores the authenticated viewer after a full page reload with no second bootstrap or auth exchange
logout blanks protected data while revocation is held, settles anonymous custody, and stays anonymous across reload
changing the fixture email preserves issuer-subject identity while a second external subject cannot read the predecessor private note
admin token, impersonation capability, private backend origin, provider assertion, and Snapback bearer never cross the browser bundle or URL boundary
password-auth-custody-witness: a real browser adopts password signup into AuthCoordinator IndexedDB custody and restores it after full reload without another signup
logout settles anonymous custody, public password signin adopts a new session, and a second full reload restores it without another signin
no admin token, impersonation capability, password, or bearer crosses the browser module or URL boundary

capabilityGaps: Draft LLP 0151's first-party provider adapter and sender-constrained OAuth completion protocol
production challenge delivery and an admitted hosted auth target
a platform-owned verified issuer/subject projection or privileged provisioning API

capabilityGapsBoundary.reason: These entries describe capabilities this local witness does not exercise or claim, not current platform GAP rows.

notClaiming: a shared identity broker, generic OIDC implementation, or first-party provider integration
production email delivery; the witness uses the local capture mailbox
production auth.mintSession; this recipe does not invoke that host operation
